title: Scaling LLM Inference via Parallelism: Throughput-Latency Trade-off
abstract: arXiv:2610.19405v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) serving systems must balance latency and throughput while efficiently utilizing distributed GPU resources. This challenge arises because inference consists of two fundamentally different phases: prefill, which determines time-to-first-token (TTFT), and decode, which determines inter-token latency (ITL). The use of tensor parallelism (TP), pipeline parallelism (PP), and hybrid configurations exposes different trade-offs between these latency dimensions, making the optimal parallelism configuration highly dependent on workload characteristics, latency requirements, and context length. Moreover, despite the widespread adoption of distributed inference, there is still limited understanding of how parallelism configurations should be selected under varying workload conditions and service-level objectives (SLO). translated_title: 通过并行性扩展大语言模型推理：吞吐量与延迟的权衡
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务系统必须在有效利用分布式GPU资源的同时平衡延迟与吞吐量。这一挑战源于推理包含两个根本不同的阶段：预填充阶段决定首词元生成时间（TTFT），解码阶段决定词元间延迟（ITL）。张量并行（TP）、流水线并行（PP）以及混合配置的使用在这些延迟维度之间呈现出不同的权衡，使得最优并行配置高度依赖于工作负载特征、延迟需求和上下文长度。此外，尽管分布式推理已被广泛采用，但对于在不同工作负载条件和服务级别目标（SLO）下应如何选择并行配置，人们的理解仍然有限。在本文中，我们开发了一个系统性框架，通过吞吐量……
tldr: 提出了一个系统性框架来刻画LLM推理中张量并行、流水线并行及混合配置在吞吐量与延迟（TTFT和ITL）之间的权衡，以指导在不同工作负载特征和服务级别目标下选择最优并行配置。
en_tdlr: Proposes a systematic framework for characterizing the throughput-latency trade-offs of tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and hybrid configurations in LLM inference, guiding the selection of optimal parallelism setups under varying workloads and service-level objectives.
